comments.text: He gave the number of patents that patent examiners are looking at per year: 200 patents - I mean are you also including those coming back and forth during examination process - that would be huge - there is no time for this if you are expected to look at 200 patents per year. it is insane.

comments.text:
Eric's presentation on the patent application process is an important resource for both patent attorneys and patent applicants.

Patent attorneys will find Eric's presentation to be a helpful resource for understanding the patent process and developing strategies for their clients. Patent applicants will greatly benefit from Eric's presentation, Eric's presentation provides a unique perspective on the process from someone who has been on both sides of the table, as it provides a realistic overview of the patent process and tips for drafting strong patent applications.
The YouTube algorithms are deficient in not recognizing the great value of Eric's presentation.
